chapter.verse: Ka sanggamte aw, a minpha Topa ahi i Topa Jesu Khris' sungah upna a neite na hih mah bangun guptuam paihtuam nei kei un.
A hang pen na kikhopna sung uhah kham khutbuh bulhin puan a te deldel a silh khat hong lut henla puan a sia nipnep a silh mizawng khat zong hong lut hileh

puan a te deldel a silhpa kinbawlin ama' kiangah, “Mun hoihna hih lai-ah hong tu in,” ci napi, mizawngpa' kiangah, “Hua lai-ah va ding in,” ahihkeileh, “Ka khe-ngakna tokhom gei-ah hong tu in,” na cih uhleh
nomau' lakah deidanna a zangte, lungsim sia tawh thukhen mang a semte hilo na hi uh hiam?
Kong it sanggamte aw, na ngai un. Pasian in upna lamah mihau a suak dingin leh amah a itte' tunga a kamciam kumpigam a luah dingin leitunga mizawngte teel khin hilo ahi hiam?
Hinapi, note in mizawngpa na simmawhbawl uh hi. Mihaute cih pen no hong nuainette leh thukhen zum ah hong kaitaalte hilo ahi hiam?
No hong kisapkhiatna a zahtak-huai min a gendaite hilo ahi uh hiam?
Note pen, “Na vengte nangmahmah bangin na it ding hi,” a cih, Pasian' Laibu sunga Topa' thukhun a zui takpi na hih uhleh a hoihin a gamta na hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin maipha piaktuam na neih uhleh mawhna a bawl na hi uh a, thukhun a palsat na hihlam uh thukhun tungtawn mahin hong kilangkhia ding hi.
A hang pen thukhun a bupin zui napi, mal khat bekbek a palkha peuhpeuh thukhun a mal khempeuh a khial mah ahi hi.
A hang pen, “Angkawm kei in,” a cipa mah in, “Tualthat kei in,” zong ci veve hi. Angkawm na hihloh hangin tualthat na hihleh thukhun a palsat na hita hi.
Tua ahih manin suahtakna thukhun nuai-ah thukhenna a thuak dingte bangin kampau gamta un.
A hang pen thukhenna in a thukhuallo mi' tungah thukhualna zang lo hi. Thukhualna ahihleh thukhenna tungah gualzo-in kipak hi.
Sanggamte aw, mi khat in upna ka nei ci napi sepna tawh a zuih keileh a phattuamna bang om ahi hiam? Tua upna in amah honkhia thei ding hiam?
Sanggampa khat ahi-a sanggamnu khat ahi zongin nikten puansilh leh annek tuidawn kitasam henla
note khatpeuh in pumpi' ading a kitangsam nate bangmah pia lo pi-in, “Nuamtak om in. Khualum gilvahin om in,” na cih uhleh bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?
Tua dan mahin upna zong sepna in a zuih keileh amah guak pen a si ahi hi.
Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in, “Nang'n upna na nei a, ke'n sepna ka nei hi,” hong ci nuam ding hi. Sepna lo tawh na upna hong lak dih inla, ke'n ka hihleh sepna tawh ka upna kong lak ding hi.
Pasian khat bek om ci-in na um uh a, a hoih ahi hi. Dawite nangawn in um uh hi-um kisa-in liing deldel uh hi.
A haitat mi aw, sepna omlo upna, bangmahin kimang lo ahihlam lahtel ding ut na hi hiam?
I pupi Abraham in a tapa Isaac biakpiaktau ah luui-in diksakna ngah ahihleh tua pen sepna tawh hilo ahi hiam?
Ama' sepna tawh kitonin upna a gamtang ahihlam na thei uh a, ama' sepna tawh upna a kicing thei ahi hi.
“Abraham in Pasian um a, tua pen ama' adingin diktatna ci-in kisimsak hi,” a ci Pasian' Laibu tangtung a, amah pen Pasian' lawm kici hi.
Tua hi a, mi khat diksakna a ngah pen upna bek tawh hilo-in sepna tawh zong ahihlam na thei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin numei kizuak Rahab zong kamtaite zindo-in zawi tuam khat ah a khakkhiat ciangin sepna tawh diksakna a ngah hilo ahi hiam?
A hang pen kha tawh kikhenkhia pumpi a si ahih mah bangin sepna tawh kikhenkhia upna a si ahi hi.
